title: Extending Microsoft Power Platform Solutions with Code and AI
description: Study guide, 88-skill tracker and a 60-question practice exam for the AB-400 exam that replaced PL-400 on Oct 16, 2026.
disclaimer: Original study material and practice questions based on public Microsoft documentation. Not Microsoft exam content; the real exam may differ.

examInfo.label: Questions
examInfo.value: Not published per exam; most Microsoft exams have 40-60

examInfo.label: Time
examInfo.value: 100 minutes exam time (120 with labs) - standard for associate exams

examInfo.label: Delivery
examInfo.value: Pearson VUE: online (OnVUE) or test center

examInfo.label: Retakes
examInfo.value: 24 h after the first fail, then 14 days; max 5 in 12 months

examInfo.label: Renewal
examInfo.value: Free, open-book assessment on Microsoft Learn; window opens 6 months before expiry

examInfo.label: Microsoft Learn
examInfo.value: Available in a split screen during the exam; no extra time

exams.title: Practice Exam 1
exams.description: 60 original questions weighted to the Oct 16, 2026 skills measured, including a case study.
